units: B. Mets. 40ᵇ ניחא ליה בצ׳ he prefers clear wine (without dregs).—Fem. צִילְתָא.
<cite ref="Yevamot 113a">Yeb. 113ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>אי דעתא צ׳ היא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="R00357"><he>צילותא</he></cite>) whether his mind is at all times equally clear (though weak) or &c.
<cite ref="Gittin 70b:10">Gitt. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>התם דעתא צ׳ היא וכ׳</he> (ed. <cite ref="R00357"><he>צילותא</he></cite>) there his mind was clear, only that weakness befell him, opp. <he>שגישתא</he>.
